description: Read current file contents, extract symbol outlines, slice line ranges, or list directory entries from a repository at a specified git ref without cloning. Automatically decodes Base64 file contents into plain text UTF-8. Eager daily driver tool for inspecting source code, configuration files, and directory layouts.

end_line.description: Optional 1-based end line to slice file contents

outline_only.description: Extract top-level symbol signatures (functions, classes, interfaces, types) with line numbers to conserve tokens (default: false)

owner.description: Repository owner (user or organization, e.g. 'octocat' or 'buggycode')

path.description: Relative path to file or directory in repository (e.g. 'README.md', 'src/index.js', or '' for root)

ref.description: Git reference (branch name, tag, or commit SHA) to read from (default: default branch / HEAD)

start_line.description: Optional 1-based start line to slice file contents

name: get_file_contents
title: Get File Contents
